verdict.rationale: Maritime is infrastructure for deploying and hosting agents that customers build and configure themselves, not a platform with its own embedded AI assistant that users delegate tasks to within the product. The closest evidence (maritime-docs-16) describes pointing an external tool like Claude Code at a migration runbook, not a built-in in-product assistant for general task delegation. No documentation describes a native, built-in AI assistant for controlling or delegating within Maritime's own UI.
